capabilities.ui: business web app and reviewer renderer

limitations: Saver seats sell, schedules change and alternatives expire only when Infra applies the matching event; the App never schedules itself.
One-way awards with at most one connection; a round trip is two bookings. Award holds, cash fares, upgrades and elite status are not modelled.
Taxes and fees are recorded against opaque payment labels; no card network or real payment is involved.
Synthetic carriers, schedules and prices; text only.
